Institute Internship Program, iINT-'26 - Registration Closed!
Welcome to the Institute Internship Programme 2026 (Hybrid Mode) at IIIT Kottayam!

We are excited to introduce our Institute Internship Programme 2026 (iINT-'26), designed to engage and inspire both undergraduate and postgraduate sfudents in the exciting realms of research and innovation.

This unique prograrnme offers a flexible duration of four to eight weeks, allowing you to immerse yourself in a collaborative research environment. You have the choice to join us in person at the IIIT Kottayam campus for two weeks or to work remotely from a location of your preference.
Work closely with experienced mentors who are driven by a passion for innovation and research.
Explore new ideas and delve into interdisciplinary research projects that push the boundaries of knowledge.
Partner with a variety of research groups to expand your perspective and enhance your research skills, fostering personal and professional growth.

If you have a passion for exploration and a desire to contribute to cutting-edge research, we highly encourage you to apply. Get ready to embark on an enriching joumey that boosts your academic and professional growth!
Apply Now and Be Part of Innovation at IIIT Kottayam!

Who is eligible to apply for the Internship Program?
All undergraduate and postgraduate students currently enrolled in courses in Engineering,Computer Applications, Mathematics, Physics and Management are eligible to apply.
Can students from Arts or Science backgrounds apply?
Yes, students from Arts or Science backgrounds may apply as long as they are interested in interdisciplinary research, and have sufficient pre-requisite knowledge for the selected area.
How do I find a mentor from IIIT Kottayam?

To find a mentor, first identify your area of research interest. Then, choose faculty members who work in that area by consulting the faculty profile list on the Institute's website. You can contact the faculty via the email address or phone number provided.
Can I contact more than one faculty mentor?
Yes, you may contact multiple faculty members. However, please inform the other faculty members once you receive consent from one of them.
Should I get both the Bonafide Certificate and the NoC from my college/university?
Yes, it is mandatory to submit both the Bonafide Certificate and the NoC in the prescribed format.
Is there a shortlisting process after the registration is completed?
No, there is no shortlisting after the registration is completed. Once you have paid the registration fee and uploaded the mandatory documents, including the
consent form signed by your mentor
, your registration process will be complete. You will receive an onboarding email before the official start of the internship.
Is it mandatory to submit the Joining Report?

Yes, along with the onboarding email, the intern will receive a Joining Report. The intern should discuss the start date of the internship with their mentor. The Joining Report should be signed by the mentor and emailed to academics2@iiitkottayam.ac.in.
What is the procedure for availing an offline internship?
Please discuss your preferred start date for the offline internship with your mentor. Before you arrive at the institute,
confirm the availability of the hostel facility
with the internship team through your mentor. Make sure to communicate your arrival date to internship@iiitkottayam.ac.in.
Is it mandatory to avail hostel facility during the offline internship?
No, provided the intern is staying in the close vicinity of the Institute.
Is it necessary to use the mess facility if I avail of the hostel facility?
Yes, it is mandatory to use both the hostel and mess facilities. Payments for both facilities should be made upon arrival at the institute campus.
What is the hostel accommodation like?
Interns will be provided with in-house accommodation options, which may be single or shared, upon making the necessary payment.

What will be the process for grievance redressal, if any?

The matter will be referred to the respective faculty mentor and FIC – Institute Grievance Committee. The decision of the Institution authority/grievance committee will be final and binding on the interns.
